question: How many distinct affine x-values are available in each frozen extension-field curve cell for the proved strict-degree rational-map separation certificate, and does the exact sample vanishing polynomial demonstrate the degree-equals-sample-size boundary?

sample_definition: all distinct x in GF(p^d) for which y^2=x^3+a*x+b has at least one solution in GF(p^d); infinity is excluded
vanishing_control: construct M_S(T)=product over x in S of (T-x) in ascending coefficient order; retain the full canonical coefficient-index encoding
positive_checks: the parent extension group order equals one plus the independently enumerated affine point count
every distinct x-fiber is either a singleton with y=0 or a two-point pair {y,-y}
M_S is monic, nonzero, has degree distinct_x_count, and evaluates to zero at every x in S
an independently enumerated degree-one curve supplies the base-field distinct-x count
controls: M_S is a nonzero degree-|S| polynomial indistinguishable from zero on exactly the complete sample set, demonstrating why the Lean bound is strict
adding one to the constant coefficient of M_S produces a nonzero evaluation at every sample x
at least one extension cell has strictly more distinct x-values than its degree-one base-field curve
measurements: parent group order, affine point count, singleton and paired x-fiber counts
distinct extension-field x count, independently enumerated base-field distinct-x count, and their ratio
raw strict cross-product degree capacity before excluding denominator poles
canonical full coefficient-index encoding of M_S
M_S zero-evaluation failures and constant-mutation rejections
producer polynomial-build/evaluation field-operation counts and producer/verifier elapsed nanoseconds as single-run diagnostics

acceptance.primary: all positive checks pass in all eight cells and producer exact fields match the independent replay
acceptance.controls: both polynomial controls pass in every cell and extension growth occurs in at least one frozen cell
acceptance.failure_policy: retain every row and every failed invariant; do not replace a curve, degree, modulus rule, sample definition, check, or control

requirements_to_evidence.evidence: Lean ZMod 3 theorem plus frozen M_S control

claim_boundary: This measures raw finite-sample capacity and the strict-degree obstruction.
